title: Spicy Fermented Fish Stew
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew originating from the Sichuan province of China, featuring fermented fish as the main ingredient. This dish is a staple in Chinese cuisine.
instructions: 1. In a large pot, heat 2 tablespoons of sesame oil over medium heat.
2. Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the sliced ginger and cook for another minute.
4. Add the ground Szechuan peppercorns and cook for 1 minute.
5. Add the fermented fish, hot pot broth, soy sauce, and scallions to the pot.
6. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes.
7. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
8. Serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.
